items.title: 馬斯克砸10億美元進軍好萊塢？傳入股Skydance
items.title_en: Elon Musk Pours $1 Billion into Hollywood? Stake in Skydance
paras: 據《Semafor》周四(22日)報導，馬斯克已向Skydance(SKYD-US)投資約10億美元，這筆注資是該公司擴大股權募資計畫的一部分。Skydance剛完成大型媒體併購，正推動業務整合與成本削減，同時面臨近800億美元的債務負擔。消息傳出後，股價下跌約1%。
派拉蒙已於10月6日完成收購華納兄弟探索，合併後公司更名為Skydance，股票代號也改為SKYD。sec.gov共同執行長David Ellison與Ynon Kreiz目前肩負整合任務，涵蓋派拉蒙與華納兄弟兩大電影製片廠、Paramount+與HBO Max兩個串流平台，以及支援旗下電視頻道與兩個新聞部門的企業職能。
Skydance先前表示，預計在三年內實現60億美元的成本節省。不過，合併後近800億美元的債務，也使公司在整合業務之際，面臨沉重財務負擔。
《Semafor》指出，馬斯克的投資承諾屬於Skydance尋求股權資金的更廣泛行動。截至報導發布，馬斯克與Skydance代表均未立即回應《CNBC》的置評請求。
馬斯克與Ellison家族過去已有多次投資往來。David Ellison的父親、甲骨文(ORCL-US)共同創辦人Larry Ellison，曾在馬斯克2022年收購Twitter、也就是如今的X時，投入10億美元。
Larry Ellison也曾於2018年投資特斯拉(TSLA-US)，並擔任該公司董事。在派拉蒙收購華納兄弟探索的交易中，他更親自為逾400億美元的股權融資提供擔保。
paras_en: According to Semafor on Thursday (the 22nd), Elon Musk has invested roughly $1 billion in Skydance (SKYD‑US). The capital injection is part of the company’s expanded equity‑raising plan. Skydance has just completed a large media merger and is pushing business integration and cost cuts while carrying about $80 billion of debt. The news sent the stock down about 1 %.

Paramount completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery on Oct. 6, and the combined company was renamed Skydance, with the ticker changing to SKYD. Co‑CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz are now tasked with integrating the two major film studios—Paramount and Warner Bros.—as well as the Paramount+ and HBO Max streaming platforms, plus the corporate functions that support the TV channels and two news divisions.

Skydance previously said it expects to achieve $6 billion in cost savings over three years. However, the post‑merger debt load of nearly $80 billion also leaves the company with a heavy financial burden as it works to integrate the businesses.

Semafor noted that Musk’s investment pledge is part of a broader effort by Skydance to raise equity capital. As of the time of the report, neither Musk nor Skydance representatives had responded to CNBC’s request for comment.

Musk and the Ellison family have a history of multiple investments together. David Ellison’s father, Oracle co‑founder Larry Ellison, put $1 billion into Musk’s 2022 acquisition of Twitter, now rebranded as X.
Larry Ellison also invested in Tesla (TSLA‑US) in 2018 and served on its board. In the Paramount‑Warner Bros. Discovery deal, he personally guaranteed more than $40 billion of equity financing.

items.title: 買公債就有高收益！投資人還願意押注生技股嗎？
items.title_en: High Yields from Government Bonds! Are Investors Still Willing to Bet on Biotech Stocks?
paras: 美國公債殖利率快速攀升，正削弱高風險生技股的吸引力。對許多尚未獲利、押注突破性療法的業者而言，投資結果可能是巨額回報，也可能近乎歸零。當相對安全的公債提供更高收益，投資人開始重新衡量承擔新藥研發風險是否值得。
據《彭博》報導，那斯達克生技指數自8月19日高點回落3.8%，同期美國10年期公債殖利率攀升近0.5個百分點，一度觸及5.34%，創2002年以來最高。該指數涵蓋近250家生技公司，今年仍上漲約25%，但近期回檔已反映利率壓力。

公債收益提高 生技業融資與現金壓力加劇

White Manna Capital創辦人暨投資長William Soliman指出，投資人如今有收益更高的無風險替代選項，使早期生技公司的投資吸引力面臨挑戰。對距離創造營收可能還有數年的企業，投資人將要求更高的風險溢價，才願意承擔臨床、監管與融資風險。
能源價格飆升與企業大舉借款投入AI，推動美債殖利率走高，也凸顯市場擔心通膨持續，讓原本資金吃緊的生技業處境更艱難。
《彭博》彙整數據顯示，那斯達克生技指數成分股中，過去一年獲利者不到四分之一，約半數公司的現金不足以支應六個月日常開銷。高利率進一步提高資金成本與再融資風險。

新藥成果仍有吸引力 資金回流卻添阻力

儘管如此，Gabelli基金經理人Elena Meng仍看好生技業長期前景，表示投資流程原本就會評估估值、資金成本與現金能支撐多久，利率變動不會根本改變其策略。
今年部分業者也交出亮眼成果。Moderna(MRNA-US)與默沙東(MRK-US)治療黑色素瘤的正面試驗數據，帶動Moderna股價在連跌四年後，今年大漲逾700%。Revolution Medicines(RVMD-US)延長晚期胰臟癌患者壽命的口服藥獲美國核准，股價今年上漲逾140%。
RBC Capital Markets分析師則認為，若AI行情退燒，生技股可望受惠於資金從科技股轉出。不過，Baird醫療產業專家Mike Perrone提醒，臨床試驗結果仍左右股價，幾家大型業者若傳出壞消息，就可能打擊市場熱情。
基因編輯業者Caribou Biosciences(CRBU-US)本月宣布終止兩項療法計畫，評估合併或被收購等選項，並規劃裁員與削減成本，今年股價已跌逾60%。Perrone指出，高利率這項明確逆風，將讓重視總體環境的跨產業投資人，對重返生技股更加猶豫。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields are climbing rapidly, eroding the appeal of high‑risk biotech stocks. For many unprofitable firms betting on breakthrough therapies, the payoff could be massive or near zero. When relatively safe Treasuries offer higher returns, investors begin to reassess whether the risk of new‑drug development is worth it.

According to Bloomberg, the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index fell 3.8% from its August 19 peak as the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield rose nearly 0.5 percentage points, briefly hitting 5.34% – the highest level since 2002. The index, which covers about 250 biotech companies, is up roughly 25% year‑to‑date, but the recent pullback reflects pressure from rising rates.

Higher bond yields tighten financing and cash conditions for biotech. William Soliman, founder and CIO of White Manna Capital, said investors now have a higher‑yielding, risk‑free alternative, challenging the attractiveness of early‑stage biotech investments. For companies that may not generate revenue for years, investors will demand a larger risk premium to take on clinical, regulatory and financing risk.

Surging energy prices and massive corporate borrowing to fund AI have pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher, underscoring market worries about persistent inflation and making an already cash‑constrained biotech sector even tougher.

Bloomberg’s data show that less than a quarter of Nasdaq Biotechnology Index constituents were profitable over the past year, and about half lack enough cash to cover six months of operating expenses. High rates further raise capital costs and refinancing risk.

Despite this, Gabelli fund manager Elena Meng remains bullish on the long‑term outlook for biotech, noting that investment decisions already factor valuation, cost of capital and cash runway, and that interest‑rate moves do not fundamentally alter the strategy.

Some companies have delivered standout results this year. Moderna (MRNA‑US) and Merck (MRK‑US) posted positive trial data for melanoma treatments, sending Moderna’s stock soaring more than 700% after four years of decline. Revolution Medicines (RVMD‑US) received U.S. approval for an oral drug that extends survival in late‑stage pancreatic cancer, lifting its share price over 140% this year.

RBC Capital Markets analysts argue that if the AI rally cools, biotech could benefit from capital rotating out of tech stocks. However, Baird healthcare expert Mike Perrone cautions that clinical trial outcomes still drive stock prices, and negative news from a few large players could dampen market enthusiasm.

Gene‑editing firm Caribou Biosciences (CRBU‑US) announced this month that it is terminating two therapy programs, evaluating merger or acquisition options, and planning layoffs and cost cuts; its stock has already fallen more than 60% this year. Perrone notes that high rates are a clear headwind, making cross‑industry investors who consider the broader environment more hesitant to return to biotech stocks.

items.title: 美光投資思維該轉變了？分析師：AI記憶體需求是場馬拉松
items.title_en: Is Micron's Investment Thinking Due for a Shift? Analyst Says AI Memory Demand Is a Marathon
paras: 美光(MU-US)近期股價疲弱，反映投資人再度質疑人工智慧(AI)支出的持久性。根據《MarketWatch》訪調的多名分析師，市場對美光的期待可能需要調整：記憶體市場的成長未必很快觸頂，投資人應把眼光放得更長遠，將AI需求視為一場馬拉松，而非短跑。
Stifel分析師Brian Chin表示，雖然近期引發跌勢的疑慮並非美光獨有，但仍讓投資人思考，究竟什麼因素才能重新帶動這檔指標性AI概念股上漲。
Wedbush分析師Matt Bryson則說，若需求放緩，記憶體受到的衝擊可能比其他零組件更大，因為「問題不只是銷量或出貨量，最終還會演變成價格問題」。換言之，美光及其他記憶體供應商目前能夠收取高價，是因為需求強勁，一旦市場環境轉弱，客戶就不願再支付如此高的價格。
考量到AI泡沫不太可能立即破裂，在市場焦慮升高、基本面卻尚未出現太大變化之際，分析師會如何建議客戶應對？

記憶體市場成長還能持續多久？低本益比提供一定支撐

《MarketWatch》指出，首先值得思考的是，記憶體市場的高速成長還能持續多久。部分投資人擔心，需求可能在兩季後出現負面轉折，但Chin表示，實際情況可能是兩到三年後才發生。
他補充，只要強勁的市場環境能夠維持這麼久，美光EPS就可能遠高於目前水準。不過，Chin不認為美光的本益比會大幅攀升，目前股價約為他預估未來EPS的五倍。
從正面來看，美光目前的本益比相當低，進一步壓縮的空間有限。Chin表示，只要獲利至少能緩步成長，這項特性就能讓美光股價「具有一定的防禦性」。
Gabelli Funds分析師Ryuta Makino表示，從相對估值來看，美光具備吸引力，尤其與儲存類股相比，美光股價的估值倍數較低。

供給擴張受限 供應鏈瓶頸恐減緩產能成長

除了需求放緩，投資人還必須留意市場供給。如果美光或競爭對手增加的供給過多，可能削弱整個產業維持記憶體高價的能力，而目前各家業者都已有擴充產能的計畫。
不過，Chin指出，半導體設備製造商目前難以迅速提高晶片製造設備的供應，因此「供應鏈的摩擦將限制供給成長速度」。
他認為，記憶體市場的投資邏輯正從短跑轉向長距離馬拉松，「現階段投資美光，需要的就是這種心態。」

AI融資風險成壓力 但記憶體供需仍趨緊

接下來是融資問題。美光的現金部位持續增加，但部分AI晶片買家愈來愈依賴借貸資金，支撐整個AI生態系的運作。Makino表示，市場對AI相關投資債務不斷攀升的疑慮，正在拖累美光股價。
他指出，前沿AI研究機構與新一代雲端服務供應商的自由現金流均為負值，在此同時，記憶體價格上漲正在推升資料中心伺服器價格，「進一步加劇融資風險」。
儘管如此，Makino表示，目前供需狀況依然吃緊，他預期明年到2028年，供需還會進一步收緊。
整體而言，Bryson並未看到需求放緩的跡象，但預期記憶體相關交易仍將持續波動。
美光股價周三早盤走勢震盪，一度上漲3.6%，隨後短暫轉跌，終場上漲約2%至每股913.67美元。美光目前股價以從6月高點下跌26%，但今年來仍上漲逾三倍。
Bryson說：「運算產業的歷史告訴我們，支援各種應用需要更多記憶體。如果你相信未來會有更多AI應用，就代表需要更多記憶體來支援這些應用。」
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) has seen weak recent stock performance, reflecting renewed investor doubts about the durability of AI spending. According to multiple analysts surveyed by MarketWatch, expectations for Micron may need to be adjusted: memory market growth may not peak quickly, and investors should take a longer view, treating AI demand as a marathon rather than a sprint.

Stifel analyst Brian Chin noted that while the recent concerns driving the decline are not unique to Micron, they still prompt investors to consider what factors could reignite this flagship AI‑themed stock.

Wedbush analyst Matt Bryson added that if demand eases, memory could feel the impact more than other components because “the issue isn’t just volume or shipments; it ultimately becomes a pricing problem.” In other words, Micron and other memory suppliers can command high prices now because demand is strong, but customers will balk at paying those premiums if the market softens.
Given that an AI bubble is unlikely to burst immediately, how will analysts advise clients to respond amid rising market anxiety but still‑stable fundamentals?

How long can memory market growth continue? Low P/E provides some support. MarketWatch points out that the first question is how long the rapid growth in memory can be sustained. Some investors fear a negative turn in demand two quarters out, but Chin says the reality may not materialize until two to three years later.

He added that if a strong market environment can be maintained that long, Micron’s EPS could be far above current levels. However, Chin does not expect Micron’s price‑to‑earnings ratio to climb dramatically; the current share price is about five times his projected future EPS.

On the positive side, Micron’s P/E is currently quite low, leaving limited room for further compression. Chin says that as long as earnings can at least grow modestly, this characteristic gives Micron’s stock “a certain defensive quality.”
Gabelli Funds analyst Ryuta Makino said that on a relative‑valuation basis, Micron is attractive, especially compared with storage‑focused stocks, where Micron’s valuation multiple is lower.

Supply expansion is constrained; supply‑chain bottlenecks may slow capacity growth. In addition to demand slowdown, investors must watch market supply. If Micron or rivals add too much capacity, it could weaken the industry’s ability to sustain high memory prices, and all players already have expansion plans underway.
However, Chin points out that semiconductor equipment makers cannot quickly ramp up chip‑making equipment supply, so “supply‑chain friction will limit the speed of supply growth.”
He believes the investment logic for memory is shifting from a sprint to a long‑distance marathon, and “investing in Micron at this stage requires that mindset.”

AI financing risk is a pressure point, but memory supply‑and‑demand remains tight. Micron’s cash balance continues to grow, yet some AI chip buyers are increasingly reliant on borrowed funds to sustain the AI ecosystem. Makino says market worries about rising AI‑related investment debt are weighing on Micron’s share price.

He noted that leading AI research institutions and next‑generation cloud service providers are posting negative free cash flow, while rising memory prices are pushing up data‑center server prices, “further aggravating financing risk.”
Nevertheless, Makino says the current supply‑demand balance is still tight, and he expects it to tighten further from next year through 2028.
Overall, Bryson does not see signs of demand slowing, but expects memory‑related transactions to remain volatile.

Micron’s stock was volatile in early Wednesday trade, briefly rising 3.6% before a short dip, and closed up about 2% at $913.67 per share. The stock is down 26% from its June peak but has more than tripled year‑to‑date.

Bryson said: “History of the computing industry tells us that supporting a variety of applications requires more memory. If you believe there will be more AI applications in the future, that means more memory will be needed to support those applications.”

items.title: AI疑慮與戰火風險升溫！資金轉抱美債 10年期殖利率跌破5%
items.title_en: AI Concerns and War Risks Heat Up! Funds Shift to U.S. Treasuries as 10-Year Yield Falls Below 5%
paras: 美國公債殖利率周四(22日)大幅下滑，10年期殖利率跌破5%，為近一個月來首見。市場對人工智慧(AI)投資前景的疑慮，加上中東緊張局勢推升油價，引發股市重挫，促使投資人轉向公債避險。
美國10年期公債殖利率下跌15個基點至4.996%，為9月23日以來首次低於5%。這項指標是房貸等長期借貸成本的重要參考，其回落反映避險買盤推升公債價格。
對聯準會(Fed)短期利率政策較敏感的2年期公債殖利率，下跌14個基點至4.69%；30年期公債殖利率則下跌10個基點至5.32%。公債價格與殖利率呈反向變動，每個基點相當於0.01個百分點。
輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳周四接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，新型雲端業者的需求雖然「強勁到爆表」，但資金仍然短缺。這番談話讓AI基礎設施擴張所面臨的資金瓶頸再度受到關注，相關疑慮也使股市承壓。
中東局勢升溫則進一步加劇市場避險情緒。《紐約時報》引述匿名美國官員報導，美國與以色列正考慮在下月美國期中選舉後，恢復對伊朗發動攻擊，採取一場「短暫但密集」的軍事行動。
消息推升國際油價。西德州中質原油(WTI)期貨周四早盤上漲逾2%，站上每桶99美元、逼近100美元；全球基準布蘭特原油也上漲逾2%，突破每桶111美元。
在AI投資疑慮與地緣政治風險夾擊下，資金撤出股票、轉向公債，帶動美債殖利率明顯回落。
持續更新...
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields fell sharply on Thursday (the 22nd), with the 10-year yield slipping below 5% for the first time in about a month. Doubts about the outlook for AI investments, combined with rising oil prices due to Middle‑East tensions, triggered a steep equity sell‑off and pushed investors toward Treasury safe havens.

The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield dropped 15 basis points to 4.996%, marking the first time since September 23 that it fell below 5%. This benchmark is a key reference for long‑term borrowing costs such as mortgages, and its decline reflects safe‑haven buying that lifted Treasury prices.

The 2-year Treasury yield, which is more sensitive to the Fed’s short‑term rate policy, fell 14 basis points to 4.69%, while the 30-year yield slipped 10 basis points to 5.32%. Treasury prices move inversely to yields, with each basis point equal to 0.01 percentage point.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC on Thursday that demand from new cloud providers is "off the charts," yet funding remains tight. His comments revived focus on the financing bottleneck facing AI infrastructure expansion, adding to the market’s pressure.

Escalating tensions in the Middle East further heightened safe‑haven sentiment. The New York Times, citing an anonymous U.S. official, reported that the United States and Israel are considering a "short but intense" military action against Iran after next month’s U.S. midterm elections.

The news pushed international oil prices higher. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures rose more than 2% in early Thursday trade, breaking above $99 a barrel and nearing $100, while the global benchmark Brent crude also climbed over 2% to surpass $111 a barrel.
Faced with AI investment doubts and geopolitical risk, money fled equities and moved into Treasuries, driving a noticeable pull‑back in U.S. bond yields.
Continuously updating...

items.title: AI愈砸錢債市愈不安！Meta信用風險指標創新高
items.title_en: AI Spending Fuels Bond Market Unease! Meta Credit Risk Indicator Hits New High
paras: Meta(META-US)擴大資本支出計畫，再度引發市場對科技巨頭舉債投入人工智慧(AI)建設的疑慮。公司信用風險指標周四(22日)盤中升至歷史新高，債券也走弱，反映投資人擔心，在債券供給已相當充裕的市場中，科技業可能進一步增加發債規模。
根據ICE Data Services數據，Meta五年期信用違約交換(CDS)報價盤中最多上升8.9個基點，至約119.3個基點，創這類合約約一年前開始活躍交易以來最高。CDS可用於對沖債務違約風險，報價上升代表投資人為債務購買保障的成本增加。
這波信用風險疑慮也波及其他大型雲端與晶片業者，甲骨文(ORCL-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)及博通(AVGO-US)的CDS報價同日均上揚。
Meta揭露，已承諾未來為各類租賃與合約支出約8250億美元，其中許多涉及AI運算能力與基礎設施，高於7月公布的近7000億美元。這些承諾涵蓋未來不同期間，並非單一年度支出。
公司也將今年資本支出預估區間下限，由1300億美元提高至1350億美元，上限維持1450億美元，但未提供明年的資本支出指引。
與此同時，Meta第三季自由現金流轉為負21.2億美元，相較之下，第二季為正7.84億美元，去年第三季則為正106.25億美元，顯示公司在大規模投資下，現金流狀況明顯轉弱。
除了CDS報價攀升，Meta公司債相對美國公債的表現也轉弱。根據Trace數據，其2036年到期、票面利率5.25%的債券，風險溢價擴大6個基點至1.2個百分點，亦即投資人要求的殖利率較美國公債高出約120個基點，才願意持有這筆債券。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) is expanding its capital‑expenditure plan, reigniting market concerns about tech giants borrowing heavily to fund artificial‑intelligence (AI) projects. The company’s credit‑risk metric rose to a historic high during Thursday’s (22nd) trading, and its bonds weakened, reflecting investor worries that, in a market already flush with bond supply, the tech sector may further increase its issuance volume.

According to ICE Data Services, Meta’s five‑year credit‑default swap (CDS) price rose up to 8.9 basis points intraday, reaching about 119.3 basis points – the highest level since these contracts began trading actively roughly a year ago. CDS contracts are used to hedge debt‑default risk, and a higher price means the cost of buying protection against the debt has increased.
The credit‑risk concerns also spread to other large cloud and semiconductor players, with CDS spreads for Oracle (ORCL‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US) all climbing on the same day.

Meta disclosed that it has pledged roughly $825 billion in future lease and contract commitments, many tied to AI computing power and infrastructure, up from the nearly $700 billion announced in July. These commitments span multiple future periods and are not confined to a single fiscal year.

The company also raised the lower bound of its 2024 capital‑expenditure outlook from $130 billion to $135 billion, keeping the upper bound at $145 billion, while providing no guidance for next year’s cap‑ex.

Meanwhile, Meta’s free cash flow turned negative $2.12 billion in the third quarter, compared with a positive $784 million in the second quarter and a positive $10.625 billion in the same quarter last year, indicating a marked weakening of cash‑flow conditions amid massive investment.

In addition to rising CDS spreads, Meta’s corporate bonds have underperformed relative to U.S. Treasuries. Trace data show that the 2036‑maturity bond with a 5.25% coupon saw its risk premium widen by six basis points to 1.2 percentage points, meaning investors now demand a yield roughly 120 basis points above the U.S. Treasury to hold the bond.

items.title: 川普怒控伊朗選前炒高油價！荷姆茲海峽運量真比戰前多？
items.title_en: Trump Accuses Iran of Inflating Oil Prices Ahead of U.S. Midterm Election; Is Hormuz Traffic Really Higher Than Pre‑War?
paras: 美國總統川普周四(22日)指控，伊朗正竭盡所能在美國期中選舉前推高油價，甚至捏造船隻遭襲與布雷消息。他在Truth Social發文宣稱，目前通過荷姆茲海峽的石油比戰前更多，並重申絕不允許伊朗擁有核武。
川普也指控伊朗持續殺害示威者及阻礙政權的人，聲稱不到七個月已有7.5萬名示威者死亡，批評國際社會與民主黨漠不關心。不過，貼文未提供支持死亡人數與「捏造襲擊」說法的證據。
川普隨後另發貼文，引用《華爾街日報》(WSJ)「波斯灣石油出口已超過美伊戰爭前水準」的標題。但報導數據涵蓋荷姆茲海峽與區域替代路線，並不代表海峽本身的運量已超越戰前。
根據船舶追蹤業者Kpler數據，截至10月18日當周，中東石油運輸量平均每日超過2400萬桶，高於戰前的2330萬桶；荷姆茲海峽運量連同阿曼灣海上轉運，則約每日1400萬桶，僅達戰前的82%。
運量回升主要受惠於美方保護下的油輪運輸安排，以及沙國、阿拉伯聯合大公國的替代管線。9月波斯灣出口的非伊朗原油中，約40%繞過海峽，高於戰前的17%。
然而，運量增加不代表風險消退。《華爾街日報》依海事機構通報統計，本月約有30起船隻遇襲事件。高額利潤吸引船東冒險，但超級油輪將波斯灣原油運往中國的運費已逼近每桶37.37美元，戰爭險最高達船價的10%。
交易商擔心，若衝突再度升級，運輸改善恐難持續。全球庫存下降也壓縮供應緩衝空間，高昂運費與保險成本最終仍可能轉嫁給消費者。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Thursday (the 22nd) that Iran is doing everything it can to push up oil prices before the U.S. midterm elections, even fabricating reports of ship attacks and bombings. In a post on Truth Social he claimed that more oil is now passing through the Hormuz Strait than before the war and reiterated that Iran must never acquire nuclear weapons.

Trump also accused Iran of continuously killing protesters and obstructing the regime, claiming that in less than seven months 75,000 demonstrators have died and criticizing the international community and Democrats for their indifference. The post, however, provided no evidence to back up the death toll or the alleged fabricated attacks.

Trump later posted another message citing a Wall Street Journal headline that “Persian Gulf oil exports have surpassed pre‑U.S.–Iran war levels.” The WSJ data, however, cover both the Hormuz Strait and alternative regional routes and do not indicate that traffic through the strait itself has exceeded pre‑war levels.

According to ship‑tracking firm Kpler, in the week ending Oct. 18 Middle‑East oil shipments averaged more than 24 million barrels per day, above the pre‑war level of 23.3 million barrels. Hormuz‑strait traffic, including transshipment in the Gulf of Oman, was about 14 million barrels per day, only 82 % of the pre‑war figure.

The rebound in volumes is mainly due to tanker movements protected by the United States and alternative pipelines in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. Of the non‑Iranian crude exported from the Persian Gulf in September, roughly 40 % bypassed the strait, up from 17 % before the war.

Nevertheless, higher volumes do not mean the risk has vanished. The Wall Street Journal, citing maritime authority reports, noted about 30 incidents of ships being attacked this month. High profits are prompting owners to take risks, and freight for VLCCs carrying Persian Gulf crude to China is now near $37.37 per barrel, with war‑risk insurance topping 10 % of the vessel’s value.

Traders warn that if the conflict escalates again, the improvement in shipping may not last. Falling global inventories are also squeezing the supply buffer, and the steep freight and insurance costs could ultimately be passed on to consumers.

items.title: 資金為AI泡沫買保險 美股「最不希望漲的類股」漲起來了
items.title_en: Investors Insure Against AI Bubble; the U.S. Sector Least Wanted to Rise Is Climbing
paras: 美股「最不希望漲的板塊」漲起來了。隨著人工智慧（AI）泡沫疑慮升溫，醫療保健股躍居標普500指數近期表現最佳類股之一，估值也從一年前較大盤折價25%，轉為略享溢價。這波漲勢背後，反映投資人正轉向防禦，為AI行情可能逆轉預作準備。
《華爾街日報》報導稱，投資人擔心利率上升可能壓抑AI資本支出，正將資金從波動較大的科技股，轉向獲利較穩定、受景氣循環影響較小的醫療保健類股。
SPDR 健康護理指數 ETF(XLV-US) 周一上漲逾2%，莫德納(MRNA-US) 大漲6.7%，必治妥施貴寶(BMY-US) 上漲4.9%。根據FactSet數據，XLV預估本益比已升至19.3倍，略高於標普500整體水準。
醫療股過去在信用緊縮、科技泡沫破裂期間，往往能跑贏大盤。如今這項防禦特性再度受到重視，但也讓漲勢帶有警訊意味：愈來愈多投資人開始為市場下跌買進「保險」。
從折價25%到溢價 市場風向逆轉
過去幾年，醫療股受到藥品定價壓力、保險公司醫療成本攀升，以及AI投資熱潮排擠，長期遭市場冷落。一年前相較大盤仍有25%的估值折價，如今已全數消失。
高盛美國醫療保健研究主管Asad Haider指出，醫療股要維持估值溢價，通常需要三項條件：投資人對醫療創新有信心、擔憂其他產業獲利能否延續，以及政策不確定性相對可控。他認為，目前這些條件已大致到位。
歷史上，醫療股享有估值溢價的時期，主要集中在2003至2007年、2013至2015年。2022年底通膨高漲、聯準會積極升息期間，也曾短暫出現。
其中，2000年代中期與當前環境具有相似之處。當時中東衝突推升能源價格，聯準會持續升息，房市繁榮支撐經濟獲利；如今則由AI扮演成長引擎。兩個時期共同的疑問都是，借貸成本持續攀升，繁榮還能維持多久？
2004至2007年，標普500預估本益比從約18倍降至約15倍，醫療股則憑藉較穩定的獲利，持續享有溢價。
龍頭成長與政策趨穩 提供支撐
醫療股上漲並非僅靠避險需求。Haider指出，嬌生(JNJ-US) 預計到本十年末將實現兩位數銷售成長；禮來(LLY-US) 受惠於糖尿病及肥胖症藥物Mounjaro、Zepbound需求強勁，今年銷售額預估成長逾30%。兩家公司合計占XLV約25%權重，對整體估值影響甚大。
政策環境也有所改善。報導指出，已有超過十家藥廠與川普政府達成協議，以價格讓步換取關稅豁免。
若民主黨在下個月國會選舉取得至少一個議院，分裂政府格局將大幅降低2028年大選前通過重大新法的可能性。
不過，醫療股內部仍有差異。瑞穗醫療策略師Jared Holz表示，隨2028年初選接近，「全民健保」（Medicare for All）討論可能再起，對聯合健康(UNH-US) 及Humana(HUM-US) 等保險公司構成壓力。相較之下，製藥與醫療器材業的政策環境，可說是多年來最穩定的。
提前防禦 也可能錯過行情
買進醫療股這張「保險單」，仍須付出代價。2006年初轉進醫療股的投資人，此後近兩年表現落後大盤，直到金融危機爆發，才展現跌幅較小的優勢，並在之後持續領先大盤長達十年。
當前關鍵在於，AI是否會成為這一輪周期的「房市泡沫」。若繁榮逆轉，以略高於大盤的估值布局醫療股，事後可能仍是划算交易；若AI行情延續，提前轉向防禦的投資人，就得承擔錯失漲勢的機會成本。
醫療股走強不代表AI泡沫即將破裂，卻反映市場已有更多資金，開始為行情反轉做準備。
paras_en: U.S. equities’ "least wanted" sector is on the rise. As concerns about an AI bubble intensify, healthcare stocks have vaulted into one of the best‑performing groups in the S&P 500 recently, with valuations shifting from a 25% discount to the broader market a year ago to a slight premium now. This rally reflects investors turning defensive and preparing for a possible reversal of the AI rally.

The Wall Street Journal reported that investors, fearing higher rates could curb AI‑related capital spending, are moving money out of volatile tech stocks and into healthcare stocks that deliver steadier earnings and are less sensitive to economic cycles.

The SPDR Health Care Index ETF (XLV‑US) jumped more than 2% on Monday, Moderna (MRNA‑US) surged 6.7%, and Bristol‑Myers Squibb (BMY‑US) rose 4.9%. FactSet data show XLV’s forward P/E has climbed to 19.3×, a shade above the overall S&P 500 level.

Historically, healthcare stocks have outperformed the market during credit tightening and tech‑bubble busts. That defensive trait is now back in focus, but it also signals a warning: an increasing number of investors are buying "insurance" against a market decline.
From a 25% Discount to a Premium: Market Sentiment Reverses

In recent years, healthcare stocks have been sidelined by drug‑pricing pressure, rising insurer costs, and the AI investment frenzy. A year ago they traded at a 25% valuation discount to the broader market; that gap has now vanished completely.

Goldman Sachs’ U.S. healthcare research head Asad Haider says that for healthcare stocks to maintain a valuation premium they typically need three conditions: investor confidence in medical innovation, worries about earnings sustainability in other sectors, and relatively controllable policy uncertainty. He believes those conditions are now broadly in place.

Historically, periods when healthcare stocks enjoyed a valuation premium clustered in 2003‑2007 and 2013‑2015, with a brief episode at the end of 2022 amid high inflation and aggressive Fed rate hikes.

The mid‑2000s share similarities with today’s environment. Back then, Middle‑East conflicts lifted energy prices, the Fed kept raising rates, and a booming housing market supported corporate profits; today, AI serves as the growth engine. In both eras the common question is how long prosperity can last as borrowing costs keep climbing.
From 2004 to 2007 the S&P 500’s forward P/E fell from roughly 18× to about 15×, while healthcare stocks kept a premium thanks to their steadier earnings.
Leading Growth and Stabilising Policy Provide Support

The healthcare rally isn’t driven solely by defensive demand. Haider notes that Johnson & Johnson (JNJ‑US) expects double‑digit sales growth by the end of the decade, and Eli Lilly (LLY‑US) is benefitting from strong demand for its diabetes and obesity drugs Mounjaro and Zepbound, projecting sales growth of over 30% this year. Together the two firms account for about 25% of XLV’s weight, heavily influencing the sector’s valuation.
Policy conditions have also improved. Reports indicate that more than ten drugmakers have struck deals with the Trump administration, offering price concessions in exchange for tariff exemptions.

If Democrats capture at least one chamber in next month’s congressional elections, the divided‑government landscape will markedly reduce the likelihood of major new legislation passing before the 2028 presidential race.

Nevertheless, there are internal differences within healthcare. Mizuho healthcare strategist Jared Holz says that as the 2028 primary approaches, the “Medicare for All” debate could resurface, pressuring insurers such as UnitedHealth (UNH‑US) and Humana (HUM‑US). By contrast, the policy environment for pharmaceuticals and medical‑device makers is arguably the most stable it has been in years.
Pre‑emptive Defense May Also Miss the Upside

Buying healthcare stocks as an "insurance policy" comes at a cost. Investors who shifted into healthcare at the start of 2006 underperformed the market for nearly two years, only showing their advantage of smaller drawdowns during the financial crisis and then outpacing the market for the next decade.

The current question is whether AI will become this cycle’s "housing‑bubble" analogue. If the boom reverses, a slightly premium valuation tilt toward healthcare could still prove a worthwhile trade; if the AI rally persists, defensive‑early investors may bear the opportunity‑cost of missing the upside.
A strong healthcare sector doesn’t signal an imminent AI‑bubble burst, but it does show that more capital is positioning itself for a potential market reversal.

items.title: AI行情選後有變？資料中心惹民怨 投資人緊盯美國期中選舉
items.title_en: Will AI Market Shift After the Election? Data Centers Spark Public Backlash, Investors Eye U.S. Midterms
paras: 美國期中選舉逼近，資料中心引發的民眾反彈，正成為AI行情的新風險。投資人擔心，若民主黨在11月3日選舉中拿下國會參眾兩院，或在關鍵州與地方選舉勝出，可能加強對資料中心的監管，影響建設進度與成本，為近年支撐美股上漲的AI投資熱潮增添變數。
據《路透》報導，美股多頭市場剛滿四周年，AI是主要推力之一。Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)等科技巨頭持續投入資料中心建設，明年全球資料中心與其他AI基礎設施支出預料將突破1兆美元，帶動企業獲利，也讓市場對任何可能拖慢擴張的障礙格外敏感。

資料中心反彈升溫 選舉成AI行情新變數

隨著大型資料中心不斷增加，民眾對環境負擔、能源成本，以及AI技術本身的疑慮也日益升高。WisdomTree(WT-US)美國投資長Christopher Gannatti指出，資料中心已成為具體的政治議題；自2022年11月ChatGPT問世以來，市場最關注的訊號，就是少數科技巨頭究竟投入多少資金興建資料中心。
投資人先前押注AI持續快速擴張，一旦成長前景受到質疑，股價便容易劇烈波動。近幾周，圍繞CoreWeave(CRWV-US)的債務疑慮，已使部分AI類股承壓，選舉與監管風險則增添另一層不確定性。
市場人士認為，在各種期中選舉結果中，民主黨同時拿下參眾兩院、從共和黨手中取得國會控制權，對AI行情構成的潛在挑戰最大。報導指出，預測市場Kalshi與Polymarket當時的交易價格，也顯示民主黨拿下兩院是最可能的結果。
資料中心爭議並非完全依黨派劃線，但民主黨選民反對聲浪較強。《路透》與益普索本月公布的民調顯示，69%的民主黨登記選民支持限制資料中心興建，共和黨選民的比例則為43%。

國會恐加強調查 全面限制建設仍有難度

分析師普遍認為，即使民主黨掌控國會，也不代表足以大幅阻礙資料中心擴張的法案能夠成為法律。
BCA Research首席地緣政治策略師Matt Gertken表示，支持AI發展的川普很可能阻擋此類立法。最終能獲通過並由川普簽署的，可能是AI監管法案，但不太可能對資本支出與建設踩下急煞車。
部分國會議員，包括民主黨人士，也可能顧慮資料中心對經濟成長的重要性，以及美國在科技競爭中落後中國的風險，不願支持嚴重妨礙建設的措施。川普周三則表示，興建資料中心的企業若希望獲得民眾支持，應向當地社區支付「紅利」。
不過，民主黨若掌控國會，預料仍會加強AI與資料中心相關聽證、調查及監督。Stifel(SF-US)首席華盛頓政策策略師Brian Gardner指出，這些程序將走向何方難以預測，也可能產生負面新聞，放大市場波動。

地方選舉牽動審批 建設時間與成本成焦點

相較於全國性立法，州與地方政府對資料中心的監管權限，更可能直接影響開發進度。因此，投資人除了關注國會選情，也緊盯州長、州議會，甚至公用事業監管委員等職位的選舉。
摩根士丹利(MS-US)策略師正追蹤德州、俄亥俄州、賓州、喬治亞州、內華達州、威斯康辛州與密西根州的州長選舉。
Beacon Policy Advisors政策研究分析師Maxwell Shulman表示，資料中心已成為州與地方選舉中的重要議題，哪個政黨掌權，可能左右業者未來面臨的法規與限制。由於投資集中於特定地區，這些資金流入州的選情尤其值得關注。
紐約梅隆銀行(BK-US)旗下BNY Wealth資深股票分析師Kevin Shea認為，資料中心政策的不確定性不太可能讓AI投資主題偏離軌道，但可能改變建設時程與成本，而這正是投資人必須評估的風險。
paras_en: The approaching U.S. midterm elections and the public backlash against data centers are becoming a new risk for the AI market. Investors worry that if Democrats win both chambers of Congress in the November 3 election, or secure key state and local races, they may tighten regulation of data centers, affecting construction timelines and costs, and adding uncertainty to the AI investment boom that has recently driven U.S. equities higher.

According to Reuters, the U.S. bull market has just celebrated its fourth anniversary, with AI as a key driver. Tech giants such as Alphabet (GOOGL-US) and Amazon (AMZN-US) continue to pour money into data‑center construction, and global spending on data centers and other AI infrastructure is expected to exceed $1 trillion next year, boosting corporate profits and making the market especially sensitive to any obstacles that could slow expansion.

Public opposition to data centers is heating up, turning the election into a new variable for the AI market. As large data centers multiply, concerns grow over environmental impact, energy costs, and the AI technology itself. WisdomTree (WT-US) U.S. Investment Chief Christopher Gannatti notes that data centers have become a concrete political issue; since ChatGPT’s debut in November 2022, the market’s most watched signal has been how much the few tech giants are investing in building data centers.

Investors previously bet on rapid AI expansion, but if growth prospects are questioned, stock prices can swing wildly. In recent weeks, debt concerns surrounding CoreWeave (CRWV-US) have put pressure on some AI stocks, and election‑related regulatory risk adds another layer of uncertainty.

Market participants believe that among the possible midterm outcomes, a Democratic sweep of both the House and Senate – taking control of Congress from Republicans – would pose the greatest challenge to the AI rally. The report notes that market predictions on platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket at the time also indicated a Democratic win in both chambers as the most likely scenario.

The data‑center controversy is not strictly partisan, but Democratic voters show stronger opposition. Reuters and Ipsos polls released this month show that 69% of registered Democratic voters support limiting data‑center construction, compared with 43% of Republican voters.

Congress may intensify investigations, but a blanket ban on construction remains unlikely. Analysts generally agree that even if Democrats control Congress, it does not guarantee that legislation significantly hindering data‑center expansion would become law.

Matt Gertken, chief geopolitical strategist at BCA Research, says a pro‑AI Trump is likely to block such legislation. The only bill that might pass and be signed by Trump could be an AI‑regulation act, but it is unlikely to slam the brakes on capital spending and construction.

Some members of Congress, including Democrats, may also consider the importance of data centers for economic growth and the risk of the U.S. falling behind China in the tech race, making them reluctant to back measures that severely impede construction. Trump said on Wednesday that companies building data centers should pay “dividends” to local communities to gain public support.

Nevertheless, if Democrats control Congress, they are expected to increase hearings, investigations and oversight related to AI and data centers. Brian Gardner, chief Washington policy strategist at Stifel (SF-US), notes that the direction of these processes is hard to predict and could generate negative news, amplifying market volatility.

State and local elections influence permitting, making construction timelines and costs a focal point. Compared with federal legislation, state and local regulators have more direct power to affect data‑center development schedules, so investors watch not only congressional races but also gubernatorial, state‑legislature and utility‑commission contests.
Morgan Stanley (MS-US) strategists are tracking governor races in Texas, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Georgia, Nevada, Wisconsin and Michigan.

Maxwell Shulman, policy‑research analyst at Beacon Policy Advisors, says data centers have become a key issue in state and local elections, and which party holds power could shape future regulations and restrictions. Because investment is concentrated in specific regions, the flow of capital into those states makes the electoral outcomes especially noteworthy.

Kevin Shea, senior equity analyst for BNY Wealth at Bank of New York Mellon (BK-US), believes that uncertainty around data‑center policy is unlikely to derail the AI investment theme, but it could alter construction schedules and costs, which is a risk investors must assess.

items.title: 金管會准了！永豐金證券併京城證 11/23合併基準日
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Approves! SinoPac Securities to Merge with Jingcheng Securities, Merger Effective Date Set for November 23, 2026
paras: 金管會今(22)日宣布通過永豐金證券合併京城證券，合併基準日預定為今 (2026) 年 11 月 23 日。未來經紀業務市占率將增加至5.113%，市占率排名維持第 4。
永豐金證券為擴大經紀業務規模及提升營運效率及綜效，經雙方依公司法第128條之1規定召開代行股東會職權之董事會決議通過合併案，由永豐金證券吸收合併京城證券，京城證券原有之2個據點將併入永豐金證券之另外2個鄰近分支機構，不另設分公司，合併後業務據點維持46處。
依公司申請書件說明，合併後預期經紀業務市占率增加至5.113%，市占率排名維持第4名，合併有助於擴大經濟規模，提升整體營運績效，並提供更多元化之金融商品服務。
證期局指出，永豐金證券資本額為新台幣172.3億元、京城證券資本額為2.3億元。其中，永豐金證券員工數為2668人，京城證券則為43人，員工將全數留用。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission announced today (22) that it has approved the merger of SinoPac Securities with Jingcheng Securities, with the merger effective date scheduled for November 23, 2026. After the merger, the brokerage market share is expected to rise to 5.113%, maintaining its rank at fourth place.

SinoPac Securities, aiming to expand its brokerage scale and improve operational efficiency and synergies, held a board meeting in accordance with Article 128‑1 of the Company Act to approve the merger. SinoPac will absorb Jingcheng Securities; Jingcheng’s two existing locations will be integrated into two nearby SinoPac branches, with no new subsidiaries created, and the total number of business locations will remain at 46.

According to the companies’ application documents, the post‑merger brokerage market share is projected to increase to 5.113%, keeping the fourth‑place ranking. The merger is expected to broaden economies of scale, boost overall operational performance, and provide a more diversified range of financial product services.

The Securities and Futures Bureau noted that SinoPac Securities has a capital of NT$17.23 billion, while Jingcheng Securities has a capital of NT$0.23 billion. SinoPac employs 2,668 staff members and Jingcheng 43 staff members, all of whom will be retained.

items.title: 台積電評估赴美德州擴產 同步尋求無稀土馬達降低中國供應風險
items.title_en: TSMC Evaluates Expanding Production in Texas While Seeking Rare‑Earth‑Free Motors to Reduce China Supply Risk
paras: 2026年10月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 隨著AI晶片需求持續超過供給，台積電(2330-TW)正評估進一步擴大美國製造布局，除了既有的亞利桑那州投資計畫，也已派遣團隊前往德州尋找設廠機會。另一方面，面對中國加強稀土出口管制，台積電也開始尋求不使用稀土材料的設備零組件，希望降低晶圓廠自動化設備對中國供應鏈的依賴。
台積電董事長暨總裁魏哲家證實，公司正與馬斯克提出的Terafab晶片製造計畫進行討論，對參與合作或持有相關製造設施保持開放態度。同時，今日也傳出，台積電已向設備供應商了解採用無稀土馬達的可行性，相關評估仍處於初期階段，尚未大規模導入。
稀土磁鐵廣泛使用於工業馬達，包括晶圓廠自動化設備的傳動系統。中國自2025年起對部分稀土材料、磁鐵及加工技術實施出口管制，使半導體設備供應鏈面臨潛在斷料風險。對高度自動化的先進晶圓廠而言，一旦關鍵馬達零組件無法正常取得，可能影響設備維修及產線運作。
事實上，無稀土馬達技術已逐步商業化。ABB、西門子Siemens、WEG及日本電產Nidec等國際大廠，均持續擴大同步磁阻馬達產品布局，相關產品已可達到IE5超高效率等級，主要應用於工業泵浦、風扇及空壓機等設備。台灣東元(1504-TW)也已量產不使用稀土磁鐵的高效率同步磁阻馬達，並實際應用於電子廠廠務水泵，產品已銷往歐美市場。
從市場規模來看，研究機構Mordor Intelligence預估，全球同步磁阻馬達市場將由2024年的1.95億美元，增加至2030年的2.40億美元，年複合成長率約3.63%。過去企業採用這類馬達主要著眼於節能效率，如今隨著中國稀土出口限制增加供應不確定性，降低對稀土磁鐵的依賴也逐漸成為設備採購考量。
不過，現有無稀土馬達主要用於工業及廠務設備，若要進一步導入半導體精密製程設備，仍須符合設備原廠對控制精度、運轉穩定性及可靠度的要求。台積電目前僅處於供應商評估階段，尚未確認採用產品或合作廠商，後續替代設計及設備驗證進度仍有待觀察。

paras_en: October 22, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – As demand for AI chips continues to outstrip supply, TSMC (2330‑TW) is assessing further expansion of its U.S. manufacturing footprint. In addition to its existing Arizona investment plan, the company has dispatched a team to Texas to explore plant opportunities. Meanwhile, facing tighter Chinese rare‑earth export controls, TSMC is also looking into equipment components that do not use rare‑earth materials, aiming to lower its fab automation reliance on Chinese supply chains.

TSMC Chairman and President Wei Che‑chia confirmed that the company is discussing participation in Elon Musk’s Terafab chip‑manufacturing project and remains open to cooperating on or holding related manufacturing facilities. At the same time, reports say TSMC has queried equipment suppliers about the feasibility of using rare‑earth‑free motors; the assessment is still in its early stages and has not yet been rolled out on a large scale.

Rare‑earth magnets are widely used in industrial motors, including the drive systems of semiconductor fab automation equipment. Starting in 2025, China will impose export controls on certain rare‑earth materials, magnets and processing technologies, creating a potential material‑supply risk for the semiconductor equipment supply chain. For highly automated advanced fabs, an inability to obtain critical motor components could disrupt equipment maintenance and production line operation.

In fact, rare‑earth‑free motor technology is gradually becoming commercialized. International giants such as ABB, Siemens, WEG and Japan’s Nidec are expanding their synchronous reluctance motor product lines, with offerings that achieve IE5 ultra‑high efficiency ratings and are used in industrial pumps, fans and compressors. Taiwan’s TECO (1504‑TW) has also mass‑produced high‑efficiency synchronous reluctance motors that do not use rare‑earth magnets, deploying them in water‑pump systems for electronics factories and exporting the products to Europe and the United States.

In terms of market size, research firm Mordor Intelligence estimates the global synchronous reluctance motor market will grow from $195 million in 2024 to $240 million by 2030, a compound annual growth rate of about 3.63%. Historically, companies adopted these motors mainly for energy‑saving efficiency; now, with China’s rare‑earth export restrictions adding supply uncertainty, reducing reliance on rare‑earth magnets is becoming an increasingly important procurement consideration.

However, existing rare‑earth‑free motors are primarily used in industrial and plant‑facility equipment. To be introduced into semiconductor precision‑process equipment, they must meet original‑equipment‑manufacturer requirements for control accuracy, operational stability and reliability. TSMC is currently only at the supplier‑evaluation stage, has not confirmed any product adoption or partner, and further design substitution and equipment validation progress remains to be seen.
